title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Information Technology Manager at LEDN

LEDN is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.

Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.

What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.

Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments.

The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.

You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.

You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise.

This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.

You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.

You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.

You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.

You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.

You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)

You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.

Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.

You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.

You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • Knowledge of working with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Remote support experience to people in multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • Writing skills in tickets, email or Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, and concise writing style; sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • Knowledge of PGP and commitment to security.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • Ability to troubleshoot according to OSI model layers methodically.
  • Self‑management and ability to scope projects, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills.
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (experience with these environments). No certifications required.
  • Experience using tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to reduce effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will: have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.

Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.

Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.

Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.

Have worked in a remote environment before.

Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

Competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.

Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.

Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

A career that provides you with purpose in your job.

We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Selection Process

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted.

As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: pharmacovigilance associate

Pharmacovigilance Associate - Brazil - Remote

ICON plc is a world‑leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

We are currently seeking a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate at ICON, you will be instrumental in ensuring the safety and efficacy of pharmaceutical products by managing and overseeing pharmacovigilance activities. You will collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and to maintain the highest standards of patient safety.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leading the collection, evaluation, and processing of adverse event reports to ensure timely and accurate reporting in accordance with regulatory guidelines and company policies.
  • Conducting thorough data analysis and interpretation of safety data, identifying trends and potential safety signals that require further investigation.
  • Preparing and submitting comprehensive periodic safety update reports (PSURs) and other regulatory documents, ensuring compliance with international regulations.
  • Collaborating with medical and clinical teams to assess the clinical relevance of reported adverse events and contribute to risk management activities.
  • Overseeing the maintenance and integrity of pharmacovigilance databases, ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with data management standards.
  • Providing training and mentorship to junior team members on pharmacovigilance processes, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
  • Engaging in audits and inspections conducted by regulatory authorities, ensuring readiness and compliance with all relevant pharmacovigilance requirements.
  • Staying informed on evolving regulatory guidelines and industry best practices to continually enhance the pharmacovigilance processes within the organization.

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Extensive experience in pharmacovigilance or drug safety, with a strong understanding of relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Proven ability to manage the pharmacovigilance process effectively, including adverse event reporting and signal detection.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across cross‑functional teams.
  • Proficiency in pharmacovigilance databases and data management systems, as well as Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive patient information with discretion.

What ICON can offer you:

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well‑being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

  • Various annual leave entitlements
  • A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
  • Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
  • Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24‑hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well‑being.
  • Life assurance
  • Flexible country‑specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

description:

Selecione a frequência (em dias) de recebimento de alertas:

Nós acreditamos que a energia que você dedica à sua carreira merece retorno. Por isso, reconhecemos a dedicação das nossas pessoas e estamos sempre em busca de quem deseja fazer a diferença e construir uma trajetória próspera e segura.

Na CPFL, você encontra um ambiente sólido para crescer com confiança, com segurança para evoluir e espaço para construir um futuro com propósito.

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial.

Empresa: CPFL Brasil – Uma empresa do Grupo CPFL Energia.

  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em direito ou economia;
  • Necessária experiência com regulação e comercialização, com foco em geração e mercado livre de energia;
  • Necessário conhecimento aprofundado acerca do arcabouço legal/regulatório do Setor Elétrico;
  • Diferencial conhecimento de estrutura tarifária;
  • Necessário inglês avançado (utilização no dia a dia para reuniões e elaboração de apresentações);
  • Disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencial em Campinas/SP.

O seu dia a dia:

  • Monitorar continuamente alterações legais, infralegais e regulatórias, analisando documentos de ANEEL, MME, CCEE, ONS, EPE e agências estaduais, para identificar riscos e oportunidades para os negócios.
  • Realizar análises técnicas dos impactos regulatórios sobre ativos e produtos, utilizando modelos e dados setoriais, com o objetivo de propor ajustes e mitigadores, além de identificar oportunidades, quando houver.
  • Elaborar e revisar contribuições técnicas para participações públicas, assegurando alinhamento institucional e profundidade técnica dos argumentos.
  • Colaborar com a elaboração de manifestações e recursos administrativos, junto a órgãos reguladores, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos e a defesa dos interesses da empresa.
  • Analisar preços, encargos setoriais e projeções tarifárias, utilizando ferramentas analíticas para avaliar impactos no Ambiente de Contratação Livre (ACL).
  • Representar tecnicamente a empresa em fóruns, grupos de trabalho e associações setoriais, defendendo posicionamentos estratégicos e promovendo articulação institucional.
  • Analisar e propor ajustes regulatórios aplicáveis aos produtos de comercialização, com foco em competitividade, inovação e conformidade.
  • Interpretar normativos regulatórios aplicáveis a projetos de geração, incluindo temas de conexão e transmissão, para orientar áreas técnicas e jurídicas.
  • Contribuir com o planejamento estratégico regulatório do grupo, propondo ações e metas alinhadas à agenda institucional.
  • Apoiar áreas internas com pareceres regulatórios especializados, assegurando segurança jurídica e técnica nas decisões corporativas.
  • Desenvolver materiais executivos para alta liderança, traduzindo temas regulatórios complexos em linguagem acessível e estratégica.
  • Fortalecer o relacionamento com stakeholders estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e institucional em temas regulatórios.

Informações Adicionais / O que esperamos de você:

  • Capacidade Técnica: Conhecimento da estrutura regulatória do setor elétrico e suas alterações, com foco nas regras de comercialização de energia no Brasil.
  • Análise Crítica: Habilidade para identificar riscos e oportunidades de negócios a partir das mudanças regulatórias, propondo e negociando melhorias na regulação do setor elétrico e nas regras de comercialização de energia.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Competência para acompanhar publicações relevantes no DOU e pautas regulatórias nas Reuniões da Diretoria da ANEEL, além de representar os negócios não regulados do Grupo CPFL junto às autoridades competentes e associações de agentes de mercado.
  • Colaboração e Influência: Capacidade de suportar a construção de contribuições às consultas públicas, tomadas de subsídios e demais atos regulatórios relacionados ao Setor Elétrico, interagindo com a Diretoria Executiva do grupo CPFL e áreas internas clientes.
  • Proatividade e Inovação: Elaboração de estudos e pareceres regulatórios para diversas áreas dos negócios não regulados, clientes, fornecedores e públicos diversos, sempre buscando maximizar o resultado consolidado do Grupo CPFL.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Wellhub;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you’ll join a mission‑driven, fast‑paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting‑edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking an Accounts Payable Specialist to play a critical role in ensuring accurate, timely payments and building scalable procurement processes at TRM. As a fully remote, global company, TRM requires an AP function that is both efficient and strategic—balancing day‑to‑day execution with process improvements that strengthen vendor relationships, support healthy cash flow, and raise standards for financial discipline.

You will join TRM’s high‑performing Finance team, which leads with ownership, accountability, and a commitment to excellence. Partnering closely with Finance, HR, and cross‑functional teams, you’ll ensure invoices are processed on time, vendors are supported seamlessly, and AP systems evolve to meet the needs of a fast‑growing organization.

The impact you will have:

  • Own payment operations : Consistently achieve >95% on‑time and accurate payments while completing AP close within target timelines to support cash flow visibility.
  • Enhance vendor & employee experience : Manage Zip effectively, onboard vendors quickly, and resolve invoice/payment inquiries while maintaining >90% compliance with card submissions.
  • Streamline procurement : Develop and implement procurement processes, including vendor negotiations, policy rollouts, and measurable cost savings that establish best practices at TRM.
  • Drive system & process improvements : Identify and implement automation or workflow enhancements to reduce manual work, strengthen liability forecasting, and improve scalability.
  • Support month‑end close : Prepare and review accruals, manage prepaid expense amortization, and reconcile accounts payable to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
  • Partner cross‑functionally : Provide timely, accurate AP reporting and collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, HR, and other teams to ensure a seamless procurement and payment experience.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3–5 years of accounts payable experience, ideally in a SaaS, startup, or high‑growth environment.
  • Strong understanding of AP processes and procurement workflows; experience with Zip, Airbase, Netsuite or similar systems is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with a proven track record of processing payments and invoices reliably and on time.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills to identify process gaps, reconcile issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who builds trusted relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Ownership mindset, able to manage multiple AP responsibilities simultaneously while driving continuous improvement.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • High‑Priority Requests: For P1 items, able to immediately jump in and resolve employee/vendor requests for urgent, time‑sensitive purchases within the same day, without compromising accuracy.
  • Policy Rollouts: When a new procurement or AP policy is introduced, able to implement the change in systems and workflows within 1 week of rollout.
  • Vendor Invoice Processing & Communication: Upload vendor invoices to the system within 24–48 hours of receipt and respond to vendor email inquiries within 1 business day.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact‑Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high‑impact challenges in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you’ll be joining a team that’s highly engaged, mission‑driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone . If you’re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high‑velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you.

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real‑world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote‑first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast‑paced, high‑impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote‑first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description— we value passion, problem‑solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third‑party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Descrição da vaga. Para atuar no grupo de Hidrocarbonetos do Laboratório Nacional de Biorrenováveis (LNBR) Buscamos um(a) profissional apaixonado(a) por biotecnologia para se juntar à nossa equipe de pesquisa e desenvolvimento. O(a) candidato(a) será responsável por conduzir estudos microbiológicos e otimizar bioprocessos utilizando leveduras oleaginosas, visando a produção sustentável de lipídeos para diversas aplicações industriais.   • Ensino superior completo em Biotecnologia, Engenharias, Química ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável pós-graduação (lato ou stricto sensu) nas mesmas áreas;

  • Vivência com cultivos aeróbicos em biorreatores;

  • Clube – Telecamp;
  • Clube – Associação SESC gratuita;
  • Gympass – desconto em academias
  • Convênios com empresas que oferecem descontos.

Reafirmamos nosso compromisso com a diversidade, equidade e inclusão, incentivando a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência, neurodivergentes, mulheres, LGBTI+, de diversas etnias, gerações e corpos, além de outros grupos socialmente marginalizados.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional. Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT). Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades. A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro. Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal. Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas. Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

description:
Location

Employment Type

Full time

Department

Acquisition

Compensation

  • $60K – $65K

Here at Gaia, our employees are the foundation of our success. We believe it's super important that you are happy, healthy, and motivated.

As such, on top of a competitive market bench-marked salary, we offer private healthcare, fertility support and other benefits.

Additionally, we offer all new hires a set up budget in addition to an annual personal development budget to build your skills, knowledge, and potential. We’re working hard on our reward and recognition framework to make sure that those who are excelling above and beyond get what they deserve.

Our vision

Everyone who wants a family should have the chance to try. For the 1 in 6 families that struggle to conceive, fertility treatments are an option but they are expensive. We created the world’s first IVF insurance allowing more people who wish to be parents to pursue treatment with increased financial flexibility. Because the difference between having a child or not should not be how rich you are.

The role

From the very first moment someone considers Gaia as part of their fertility journey, we aim to offer clarity and care. That’s where you come in.

We’re looking for a BDR (Patient Support) to connect with prospects as they consider Gaia for their fertility journey.

You’ll be the first human touchpoint for patients early in their fertility journey; answering questions, building trust, and making sure they feel supported every step of the way.

This is a unique opportunity to support people at one of the most pivotal moments in their lives and help shape how Gaia shows up for them.

  • You’ll work closely with our Marketing team to manage the prospect pipeline for any patient starting their fertility journey in the early stages.
  • You’ll be acting as the main point of contact for prospects and guiding them seamlessly through the initial stages of their journey.
  • You’ll as a point of contact for clinic staff at your assigned clinics to support members book their initial consultations.
  • You’ll book initial calls between “ready to go” patients and our Member Growth Team.

Your responsibilities:

  • Manage a marketing pipeline of Gaia prospects.
  • Qualify potential members at their early stages throughout inbound forms and outbound sales calls.
  • Support MQLs to book a clinic consultation.
  • Book initial calls between Gaia Prospects and Member Growth Associates.
  • Manage all communication with Prospects via calls and email.
  • Effectively carry out processes to track prospects' initial journey and share data with clinics and the rest of the team.
  • Identify opportunities for increasing our sales pipeline to drive overall Member growth.

You’ll be a great candidate for this role if you:

  • Have minimum 1 year of experience qualifying leads and potential prospects over the phone and via inbound forms required .
  • Experience in the healthcare or fertility space (nice to have).
  • Are empathetic and deeply care about our Members - the IVF experience is incredibly stressful and empathy for what they are going through is a must.
  • Are a self-starter - you’ll be working as part of a small team but also a specific growth project, so we’ll be looking to you to help set us up for success.
  • Have strong interpersonal skills - you’ll constantly be communicating with patients, clinic staff and the rest of our company via email and phone calls.

Compensation Range: $60K - $65K

  • Realizar análise crítica das variações de contas patrimoniais e de resultado, identificando desvios e propondo ações corretivas junto às áreas envolvidas.
  • Apoiar no atendimento às auditorias internas e externas, garantindo a entrega de documentação técnica, respostas adequadas e o acompanhamento das recomendações.
  • Assegurar o correto reconhecimento contábil de provisões, contingências, ativos imobilizados e ajustes de reclassificação e impairment, com base nas normativas contábeis aplicáveis.

  • Atuar como referência técnica para a equipe contábil, promovendo o desenvolvimento e a capacitação de analistas juniores e plenos.
  • Apoiar na implantação de novos módulos ou atualizações de sistemas ERP relacionados à contabilidade, validando regras e parametrizações.

O que oferecemos

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

Overview

JOB TITLE Product Lead, Slate

LOCATION Worcester

DEPARTMENT NAME Enterprise Cloud Systems

DIVISION NAME Worcester Polytechnic Institute - WPI

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Product Lead, Slate, is responsible for the strategic oversight and continuous improvement of the Slate CRM platform, supporting functions such as admissions, enrollment, communications, and student engagement. This role will report to the Director, Enterprise Cloud Systems. The role leads the full product lifecycle—from ideation and development to deployment and optimization—to ensure the platform aligns with institutional goals and delivers measurable value. In this capacity, the Product Lead may manage a team, including direct reports such as system administrators or analysts who support Slate. They provide leadership, coaching, and performance management to ensure the team delivers secure, scalable, and user-centered solutions. The Product Lead works closely with these team members to align technical execution with product strategy and ensure seamless delivery of enhancements and support. The role requires close collaboration with stakeholders across business and technology domains to define and communicate a clear product vision. The Product Lead plays a key role in shaping the end-to-end user experience and ensuring that Slate evolves to meet the institution’s changing needs.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Product Lead for Slate, managing tenant configuration, security administration, and release planning.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshoot issues related to Slate and other enterprise cloud systems as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with the Graduate Studies team—including Recruiting & Marketing and Admissions—Summer Studies, and University Marketing to ensure system functionality aligns with strategic goals and operational needs.
  • Define and manage the Slate product roadmap, ensuring alignment with institutional goals and user needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, monitor performance, and manage transitions from development to production.
  • Serve as a liaison between business units and technical teams, translating requirements and resolving integration or customization challenges.
  • Coordinate with enterprise architects and data teams to ensure alignment of product and platform strategies.
  • Evaluate and prototype new Slate features and technologies to support innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Lead major system releases, ensuring new functionality meets business and technical requirements.
  • Mentor team members who support Slate operations and development.
  • Ensure the team maintains system performance, security, and compliance standards.
  • Align team activities with product goals, ensuring operational readiness for new features and updates.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems or related field.
  • 6+ years of relevant experience in IT, business, or higher education, with a strong understanding of end-user needs and value drivers.
  • 3+ years in progressively responsible roles across business and/or IT functions. Business-only backgrounds are acceptable if they include significant technology collaboration.
  • Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders in support of strategic initiatives.
  • Experience managing technical teams or direct reports is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (preferably Slate), design thinking principles, and modern software delivery methodologies.
  • Strong communication, time management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Salary: $95,000 (depending on experience)

Benefits: WPI offers a comprehensive package including 4 weeks of paid time off, an additional week at the end of December, 13 paid holidays, health, dental, and vision insurance, a 9.5% retirement match after one year, disability and life insurance, tuition assistance (including full WPI tuition for dependents after 3 years), and free access to the fitness center.

Description

Cyera is on a mission to protect one of the world's most valuable resources: data. Our AI-native platform gives organizations a complete view of where their data lives, how it’s used, and how to keep it safe, so they can reduce risk and unlock the full value of their data, wherever it is.

Since our founding in 2021, we’ve grown fast- Cyera-fast - securing over $1.3 billion in funding from the biggest pockets on the planet and establishing a global team. Today, Cyera is the fastest growing data security company on the planet, trusted by the Fortune 500 and beyond.

About the Team

The Brand & Creative team shapes Cyera’s visual voice across campaigns, product narratives, and go-to-market initiatives. Our work turns complex stories into clear, compelling assets that drive awareness, influence pipeline, and strengthen the brand. This team values clarity, craft, and operational excellence. The Program Manager is the connective tissue that keeps work flowing with speed and quality, aligning designers and stakeholders around crisp plans, expectations, and outcomes.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Program Manager to lead Design Operations end-to-end—from brief to delivery. In this role, you’ll run the operating cadence for a global creative team, own the intake and prioritization process, and coordinate closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, and Design. You’ll bring structure to creative work without stifling it: clear briefs, transparent timelines, measurable KPIs, and smooth handoffs. Your work ensures the right projects ship on time, to spec, and with real business impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Orchestrate day-to-day workflows across the design studio; balance capacity, run weekly planning, and keep the roadmap current.
  • Own the Creative board in Asana: triage requests, clarify briefs, define priorities and due dates, and track status through delivery.
  • Partner with global stakeholders (primarily U.S.) in Marketing, Growth, Sales, and Product to turn business needs into actionable creative plans and timelines.
  • Establish operating cadences—intake, kickoffs, reviews, approvals, retrospectives—and codify SLAs from brief to handoff.
  • Lead vendor operations: NDAs, onboarding, scopes, content coordination, deliverables tracking, and invoice alignment to budget.
  • Define and track KPIs for design projects (throughput, cycle time, on-time delivery, rework rate, stakeholder satisfaction); publish clear reports.
  • Build internal communication formats and knowledge repositories: weekly updates, quarterly reviews, playbooks, and templates.
  • Support formal planning and optimization: annual and quarterly plans, resource modeling, process-improvement experiments, and post-mortems.
  • Proactively surface risks, remove blockers, and drive crisp, timely communication across time zones.

Requirements

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years in creative operations, PMO, marketing operations, or design program management in a fast-paced environment.
  • Mastery of project management tools (Asana required) and spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets); able to build dashboards and status views.
  • Demonstrated success coordinating global stakeholders and vendors; excellent written and verbal communication in English.
  • Strong process design and change-management skills; can zoom from big picture to detail and back.
  • Ownership mindset: proactive, organized, and unafraid to raise flags early and drive decisions.
  • Flexibility to collaborate with U.S.-based teams and join occasional evening calls.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Notion/Confluence, or similar knowledge-management tools.
  • Hands-on exposure to creative/brand/design workflows; know what a good brief and review cycle looks like.

Why Join Us?

At Cyera, we care about collaboration, innovation, and agility. We take “teamwork” seriously—with our inclusive and supportive culture at the forefront—and we’re just as serious about nurturing Cyerans to grow, both personally and professionally.

Feel free to apply even if your experience doesn’t tick every box.

We’re building something special here—and we welcome Cyerans with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Security Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a full‑time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin‑backed loan platform.

Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long‑term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito‑based identity architecture with stronger, phishing‑resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave‑based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • Passion for progress, adaptability, resilience, comfortable navigating ambiguity.
  • Builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

Benefits and Opportunity

Ledn offers a comprehensive rewards package, competitive PTO, ownership equity, and the flexibility to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days.

We are an equal‑opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Retail

  • Solução de Problemas: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de integração, monitorando o fluxo de mensagens e garantindo a estabilidade das soluções.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes funcionais e de outras áreas para garantir que as integrações atendam às necessidades do negócio.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimentoSAPABAP .
  • Conhecimento profundo emSAPCPI (Cloud Platform Integration), incluindo a criação de iFlows e a configuração de adaptadores (SFTP, SOAP, HTTP, OData, etc.).
  • Experiência com APIs e serviços web (SOAP, REST).
  • Habilidade para analisar e resolver problemas de forma eficaz, com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificação SAPem ABAP ou CPI.
  • Conhecimento de outras plataformas de integração, como SAPPI/PO.
  • Experiência com o SAPS/4HANA.

description:
Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer

We are hiring multiple Software Engineers II and Senior Software Engineers to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home! The Microsoft 365 team is looking for software engineers to help design and build one of the fastest-growing cloud services at Microsoft.

Do you want to work on a product that ships new features every week? If so, the Microsoft 365 team would love to hear from you! We build and operate the largest enterprise cloud productivity system in the world. Across products such as Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint, we power communication, sharing, search, intelligent assistance, extensibility through Microsoft Graph, and more. We maintain high reliability and availability, strong privacy and compliance, and millisecond‑level latency. Our work combines approaches from API design, machine learning, distributed computing, workflow engines, algorithm optimization, and more. Join us to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

More About Microsoft 365

Microsoft 365 is the fastest-growing cloud services business at Microsoft. It brings together cloud versions of our most trusted communication and collaboration products—Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams—with the desktop suite of Office products in an always up‑to‑date, integrated service offering. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

More About Your Responsibilities

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high‑scale, low‑latency, always‑on, and cost‑effective to maintain and operate. They collaborate with principal engineers and architects to design components and influence common development patterns. Strong partnership and influence skills are essential, along with motivation and the ability to collaborate across teams.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation‑only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities

  • Drive projects through to delivery, removing obstacles to ensure success.
  • Contribute to the design of large‑scale distributed software services and solutions.
  • Write clean, well‑tested code.
  • Champion and improve team software engineering practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers.
  • Collaborate with related teams to achieve goals.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and contribute to onboarding documentation.
  • Participate in the on‑call rotation to monitor service health and manage incidents.

Qualifications

Main Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software design and backend service development.
  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience in an object‑oriented language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, or equivalent experience with C.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Ability to communicate technical details clearly.
  • Experience in DevOps for live services or application frameworks.
  • Cloud services experience; Azure experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to software design.
  • Passion for building reliable, well‑tested services.
  • Experience with Agile and iterative development processes.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset: eager to learn, embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, and learn from feedback and others’ success.
  • Commitment to diversity and inclusion: fostering a culture where everyone can be authentic and heard.
  • Confident and articulate in expressing ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Self‑motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

title: Director, Product Operations
description:
Who we are:

At Mediafly, we help the world’s top revenue teams work smarter and achieve measurable impact. Our platform brings together sales enablement, content, and performance insights so sellers have the coaching, tools, and intelligence they need to succeed. By weaving value selling into every workflow, we empower teams to accelerate deal cycles, boost win rates, and prove ROI.

For you, that means joining a company where innovation meets purpose—where your work helps businesses deliver more meaningful buyer experiences and drives results that truly matter. You’ll be part of a collaborative, growth-focused team that values expertise, creativity, and human connection.

The Director, Product Operations will bring order, consistency, and predictability to how our product organization works. You’ll lead and mentor a small team of Product Managers while building the operational backbone that keeps initiatives moving — ensuring that strategy translates into execution smoothly and efficiently.

This role is perfect for someone who loves clarity, thrives on process, and can bring harmony to a fast-moving cross-functional environment. You’ll be the person who ensures our product teams are aligned, our documentation is standardized, and nothing slips through the cracks.

Responsibilities of a Director, Product Operations:

  • Establish and own frameworks, rituals, and tools that improve consistency, transparency, and accountability across the product organization.
  • Mentor two Sr PMs, helping them prioritize effectively, communicate clearly, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
  • Enforce a unified “rulebook” for PRDs, discovery briefs, and other product artifacts. Ensure everything lives in the right place, follows the right format, and tells the right story.
  • Build repeatable systems for how work moves from idea to delivery — including how we plan, track, and review progress.
  • Champion tools like Productboard, Confluence, and Jira to drive cross-functional clarity.
  • Keep the trains running on time. Coordinate dependencies, track timelines, and help teams anticipate and unblock risks before they slow momentum.
  • Work closely with Design, Engineering, and GTM to make sure everyone understands priorities, status, and the “why” behind decisions.

We would love to meet you if you have:

  • 8+ years in product or program management, with at least 2 years leading teams.
  • Previous experience working in a SaaS company, ideally in a product operations or product management function.
  • Deep experience building scalable processes for product planning, documentation, and release management.
  • A knack for simplifying complexity and creating structure without bureaucracy.
  • Strong communication skills — able to align executives and empower ICs alike.
  • Familiarity with tools like Productboard, Jira, and Confluence, and the judgment to know when a process helps (and when it hinders).

Success Looks Like:

  • Every product initiative has a clear owner, definition of success, and consistent documentation.
  • The team knows what’s next, what’s blocked, and where to find information — always.
  • Leadership can trust that roadmaps, PRDs, and metrics are complete, standardized, and up to date.
  • Product Managers and cross-functional partners feel empowered, supported, and aligned.

US Base Salary: $155,000 - $175,000

Canada Base Salary: CA$180,000 - CA$200,000

Location and Work Setup:

This is a 100% remote position with a collaborative team that values flexibility and trust. We use modern communication and collaboration tools to stay connected and productive across time zones.

title: Gerente de Conservação – Agricultura e Pecuária Regenerativas no Cerrado
description:
Gerente de Conservação – Agricultura e Pecuária Regenerativas no Cerrado

O que buscamos em você

Você está buscando uma carreira para ajudar pessoas e a natureza? Guiada pela ciência, a TNC cria soluções inovadoras e práticas para os maiores desafios do mundo, de forma que pessoas e natureza possam prosperar juntas. Estamos em busca de alguém apaixonado pelo Cerrado e motivado por fazer parte de uma transformação na cadeia da agricultura e da pecuária, com perfil solucionador de problemas e com habilidade de criar e fortalecer relações. Uma pessoa energizada, dinâmica, com iniciativa, habilidades interpessoais sólidas e alta capacidade de trabalho em equipe. Esperamos que você traga sua ampla experiência na gestão de portfólio e equipes e no trabalho colaborativo, para garantir a implementação e continuidade eficiente e efetiva de projetos e iniciativas da TNC Brasil. Junte-se a nós!

Descrição da posição

Na posição de Gerente de Conservação – Agricultura e Pecuária Regenerativas no Cerrado, você será responsável por liderar e gerenciar um portfólio diversificado de iniciativas de conservação, governança, desenvolvimento sustentável ligados à agenda de agricultura e pecuária no Cerrado, visando fomentar uma transição para sistemas regenerativos. Você lidera uma equipe que lida com problemas sistêmicos e complexos relacionados à expansão das cadeias produtivas, uso e ocupação do solo, mecanismos financeiros para financiamento da agricultura e pecuária sustentável e governança territorial. Deverá conectar a proteção da biodiversidade, evidências baseadas em ciências, relação com comunidades locais e parceiros locais/regionais à implementação dos projetos de Agricultura Regenerativa. Servirá como ponto focal de projetos a parceiros chave do setor privado, outras organizações de conservação, fundações e comunidade acadêmica. Esta posição reportará para o/a Diretor/a de Conservação para o Cerrado.

A atuação da TNC busca sempre alcançar resultados mensuráveis e de impacto, considerando não apenas a avaliação de projetos implementados pela TNC mas também do ganho de escala através de arranjos de governança e parcerias fomentadas ou fortalecidas. Garantiremos que as parcerias estratégicas foram estabelecidas, que atores chave tem capacidade para execução e que existem metas claras de curto prazo a serem perseguidas. Garantiremos o avanço contínuo dos projetos a partir de uma gestão ágil, organizada e transparente.

Essa vaga é home-office, por isso características como auto-gestão e auto-motivação são importantes. Profissionais de qualquer região do Brasil são elegíveis, no entanto, será dada prioridade para profissionais que residam no Cerrado, especialmente nos estados de Mato Grosso, Goiás ou Tocantins.

Responsabilidades e Escopo de trabalho:

  • Segue e promove ativamente nosso Código de Conduta tanto internamente quanto externamente, demonstrando de forma contínua e consistente alinhamento com nossos valores.
  • Lidera uma equipe e um portfólio de projetos relacionados à agricultura e pecuária no Cerrado Brasileiro, considerando interlocução com equipes no Brasil, América Latina e na equipe global. Serão necessárias habilidades de liderança sem relações diretas de supervisão.
  • Supervisionar equipe técnica localizada em diferentes regiões, com responsabilidade pela gestão de desempenho, formação e desenvolvimento dos profissionais supervisionados.
  • Liderar processos de monitoramento, avaliação e reporte de resultados (Trimestrais, Anuais, reportes a doadores etc.), analisando avanços e barreiras junto a stakeholders internos/externos.
  • Estabelece e mantém padrões ótimos de desempenho dentro do orçamento.
  • Redige solicitações de proposta (RFPs) para obtenção de financiamento por meio de subsídios/contratos para o programa, gere a execução técnica/financeiro dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade e gerencia o relacionamento técnico com doadores e financiadores.
  • Toma decisões estratégicas de forma independente com base em análises, informações ambíguas e contexto.
  • Negocia acordos complexos em ambientes conflituosos, com diversos perfis de organizações.
  • Apoia a liderança estratégica da Direção de Conservação para o Cerrado.
  • Realiza viagens frequentes, nacionais e/ou internacionais, incluindo noites e fins de semana.
  • Pode trabalhar em condições climáticas variáveis, em locais remotos, terrenos difíceis e perigosos, e sob circunstâncias fisicamente exigentes.

O que você trará à TNC:

  • Diploma de bacharel na área de agronomia, economia, engenharia ambiental e correlata, conservação ambiental, ou combinação equivalente de educação e experiência de pelo menos 7 anos.
  • Experiência em captação de recursos, incluindo identificação de potenciais doadores e desenvolvimento de relacionamento com doadores.
  • Experiência na gestão de projetos complexos ou múltiplos, incluindo administração financeira e coordenação do trabalho de outros profissionais e parceiros, incluindo equipe, manejo de carga de trabalho e organização de demandas.
  • Experiência em supervisão, incluindo motivação, liderança, definição de objetivos e gestão de desempenho.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de parcerias com organizações sem fins lucrativos, grupos comunitários e/ou órgãos governamentais.
  • Experiência em negociações complexas, com amplo perfil de públicos, como setor privado e produtivo, cientistas, órgãos gestores, representantes de empresas e funcionários do governo local, estaduais e federal.
  • Conhecimento em questões chave ligadas à agricultura e conservação no Cerrado, questões como expansão agrícola, desmatamento, monitoramento, mecanismos financeiros, assistência técnica.
  • Experiência com o setor do agronegócio e, preferencialmente trabalho prévio no Cerrado.
  • Capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal em inglês e português.

QUALIFICAÇÕES DESEJADAS

  • Experiência multilíngue e multicultural ou intercultural é valorizada.
  • 7 a 10 anos de experiência prévia com implementação de parcerias público-privadas, e/ou articulações multi-strakeholders e/ou no desenvolvimento e implementação de políticas públicas relacionadas à agricultura e pecuária e/ou na implementação de programas privados de agricultura e pecuária regenerativas;
  • Experiência comprovada em influenciar, desenvolver e implementar políticas e planos de conservação.
  • Conhecimento sobre tendências e práticas atuais de modelos e sistemas de transição para agricultura regenerativa, compromissos privados (como compromissos de clima e escopo 3), dentre outros.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver aplicações práticas de conceitos científicos e inovações técnicas para fins de conservação.
  • Conhecimento de métodos e padrões de sistemas de informação sobre biodiversidade e iniciativas relacionadas.
  • Comunicação clara por meio de linguagem escrita, falada e gráfica em inglês e outros idiomas relevantes.
  • Habilidade política/apurado senso político.
  • Formação e experiência na aplicação de ferramentas de gestão de projetos, tais como PMP, Prince2, Agile ou Critical Chain Project Management;
  • Experiência no Cerrado, especialmente nos estados de Mato Grosso, Goiás e/ou Tocantins será considerado diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em mecanismos financeiros será considerado um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento prático e/ou teórico sobre adaptação, justiça e emergência climática no âmbito de cadeias produtivas e sistemas alimentares.
  • Pós Graduação não é uma exigência, é um diferencial.

title: Senior Embedded Products and Software Reliability Engineer
description:
Senior Embedded Products and Software Reliability Engineer

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Embedded Reliability Engineer with a strong background in protection and control systems, energy management devices, and utility‑scale software for transmission and distribution (T&D) applications. In this role, you will lead reliability initiatives across the lifecycle of critical grid automation products, including protection relays, control devices, digital substation solutions, and advanced software platforms. Your work will directly support utility customers in achieving higher uptime, reduced lifecycle costs, and safer grid operation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform reliability modeling and statistical analysis of energy management and protection/control products to predict field performance and act as authority for reliability design decisions.
  • Develop and execute reliability test plans for hardware and software, including hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL), environmental, and stress testing for grid components.
  • Conduct and lead FMEA, FMECA, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for hardware/software failure events across embedded systems and communication layers.
  • Work with product design, systems engineering, and software teams to ensure Design for Reliability (DfR) is embedded from concept through deployment.
  • Analyze field data from deployed devices to identify systemic issues and recommend corrective/preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with utilities and customers to support grid asset performance programs and grid modernization initiatives, including IEC 61850, virtualization, and advanced diagnostics.
  • Develop and maintain reliability KPIs (e.g., MTBF, FIT rate, availability) for product lines and integrate into product development and quality programs.
  • Identify and drive adoption of predictive and condition‑based maintenance strategies using remote diagnostics, SCADA, and sensor data.
  • Consult and align with the Innovation Office and Applications team to ensure reliability priorities influence working group participation, standards leadership, and technology strategy.
  • Stay current on regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., NERC, IEEE, IEC standards) impacting utility asset reliability and cybersecurity.
  • Provide coaching, training, and guidance on reliability practices to internal teams and external stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in reliability, systems, or product engineering in the energy or utility sector.

Desired Characteristics

  • Familiar with protection & control systems, grid‑edge devices, substation automation, and utility‑grade software solutions.
  • Hands‑on experience with reliability engineering tools and standards (e.g., ReliaSoft, ISO 9001/55000, IEC 61025).
  • Familiarity with communications protocols and standards used in T&D systems: IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEEE C37.118, etc.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis platforms (e.g., Python, R, Minitab, Power BI).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to engage cross‑functional teams and utility customers.
  • Understanding of grid reliability challenges in T&D environments and willingness to travel for customer engagements.
  • Collaborative leadership across engineering, field teams, and customers.
  • Data‑driven problem‑solving mindset with attention to long‑term product health and systems thinking.
  • Proactive approach to emerging technologies and continuous improvement.
  • Master’s degree in Reliability or Systems Engineering.
  • Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) or similar professional certification.
  • Familiar with model‑based design and HIL testing (e.g., RTDS, PSCAD, EMTP) for utility applications and simulation tools used in electronics and CAD design.
  • Experience working directly with T&D utilities, supporting product deployments, failure investigations, or asset strategies.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity risk and reliability considerations for critical infrastructure.

Benefits

The base pay range for this position is $152,400.00 – $203,200.00 USD annually, with a 15% variable incentive bonus. This posting closes on October 20, 2025. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; a 24/7 nurse‑based resource and Health Coach; the Employee Assistance Program. Retirement benefits include the GE Retirement Savings Plan and a 401(k) savings opportunity with company matching and contributions. Other benefits: tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time‑off.

Relocation Assistance: No. This is a remote position.

Candidatos precisam ter fluência em React Native, com pelo menos 5 anos de experiência, e precisam saber trabalhar com programação funcional, graphQL e Postgres.

Neste papel, você vai liderar o desenvolvimento de um produto inovador para o mercado fitness, desde o planejamento e desenvolvimento das funcionalidades até os testes e deployment. Nos primeiros meses vai ser essencial botar a mão na massa e programar funcionalidades importantes para ajudar a nossa plataforma a atender às demandas dos públicos-alvo. Você vai precisar se tornar referência para a equipe na resolução de problemas e no desenho e planejamento da arquitetura da plataforma. Você vai trabalhar com bastante autonomia, liderando e crescendo a equipe de devs, mas também alinhando a construção do nosso produto com os líderes de outras frentes.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar soluções de software fullstack utilizando React Native via Expo.
  • Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento de software, incluindo planejamento, programação, teste e implementação.
  • Realizar testes para assegurar a funcionalidade, desempenho e segurança das aplicações.
  • Trabalhar de maneira independente, assegurando que as entregas estejam alinhadas com as diretrizes estratégicas da empresa.
  • Colaborar com a equipe para definir requisitos, estabelecer cronogramas e prioridades.
  • Assegurar a aderência a padrões de qualidade e desenvolvimento de software.
  • Contribuir com ideias inovadoras e resolução criativa de problemas técnicos.

Qualificações

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência comprovada como desenvolvedor(a) em React Native.
  • Imprescindível trabalhar com programação funcional, graphQL e Postgres.
  • Experiência prévia com desenvolvimento em mobile e com as ferramentas de deployment das app stores.
  • Diferencial desejável: Conhecimento em Elixir e Phoenix.
  • Sólido conhecimento em desenvolvimento fullstack e padrões de arquitetura de software.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Capacidade de colaboração para resolver problemas complexos de forma eficaz e inovadora.
  • Disposto a trabalhar no ambiente descontraído e dinâmico de uma start-up.

O que oferecemos

  • Contratação PJ.
  • Remuneração condizente com o mercado de startups.
  • Participação societária.
  • Trabalho remoto com flexibilidade nos horários de trabalho.
  • Oportunidade de liderar e montar a própria equipe.

Esta é sua chance de fazer parte de uma equipe pioneira, dedicada a moldar o futuro dos treinos personalizados. Somos uma empresa bastante recente, com 2 anos de estrada, mas que em pouco tempo já despontou à frente dos concorrentes em diversas frentes. Se você busca uma oportunidade para aplicar suas habilidades em um projeto que já está revolucionando a indústria do fitness, nós queremos ouvir de você. Venha nos ajudar a construir algo extraordinário e deixar sua marca em um produto que irá transformar a maneira como as pessoas treinam. Junte-se a nós para uma jornada empolgante e seja parte essencial de nossa história de sucesso!

  • Proatividade, pensamento crítico e raciocínio lógico.

Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, onde os profissionais têm oportunidade para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de todos os tipos de projetos, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil ou do mundo. Além disso, somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo a Great Place to Work e uma das 10 empresas que mais cresce no país há 3 anos consecutivos, segundo o Anuário Informática Hoje.

Quais são nossos valores?

  • Somos pessoas servindo pessoas
  • Pensamos e agimos como donos
  • Temos gana por performance
  • Crescemos e aprendemos juntos
  • Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade
  • Temos inovação e criatividade no nosso DNA

Todas as pessoas são bem‑vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.

Ricardo Almeida | Há mais de 40 anos fazendo história na moda nacional. Com mais de 40 anos de história, a Ricardo Almeida é uma referência na alfaiataria brasileira, sinônimo de elegância, exclusividade e excelência. Vestimos homens e mulheres que buscam transmitir confiança, poder e estilo, unindo tradição e inovação em cada criação. As peças da marca são desenvolvidas com um acabamento impecável e confeccionadas a partir de tecidos nobres, garantindo não apenas um visual elegante, mas também uma experiência única ao vestir. Acreditamos que cada detalhe importa, e é por isso que nossa dedicação à qualidade e à estética se reflete em tudo que fazemos. Entre 19 lojas próprias, presença em multimarcas e um espaço em Studio com experiência de compra personalizada, construímos um legado de excelência desde o atendimento até o produto. Estamos em constante evolução, unindo tradição com a tecnologia para reafirmar nossa comunidade e nossos valores.

  • Efetuar rotinas administrativa do caixa (abertura e fechamento);

Join to apply for the Founder’s Right Hand – Remote role at The Flex

About The Flex

At The Flex, we’re reinventing how the world rents. Renting a home should be as effortless as ordering on Amazon — instant, borderless, and intelligent. Our proprietary Property Management System powers this revolution—automating operations, optimizing pricing, and creating seamless experiences for guests and landlords alike. We’re assembling a small, elite team of builders—ambitious problem‑solvers who thrive in fast‑paced environments and take extreme ownership of results. If you want to build a global company alongside a visionary founder, this role is your gateway.

THE ROLE

As the Founder’s Right Hand, you’ll work directly with the CEO across every aspect of the business—strategy, operations, growth, partnerships, and product. You’ll be the founder’s execution partner, turning ideas into results and ensuring the company runs with speed, precision, and focus. This is a high‑trust, high‑impact position designed for someone who wants to learn how to build a global company from the inside and eventually lead one.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Execution – Translate ideas into actionable plans and ensure flawless delivery across product, operations, and growth.
  • Project Ownership – Lead cross‑functional initiatives—from new city launches to process automation—and drive them to completion.
  • Operational Support – Handle critical business priorities, streamline workflows, and eliminate bottlenecks.
  • Research & Analysis – Conduct deep dives into markets, competitors, and new opportunities to support decision‑making.
  • Talent & Recruiting – Help identify and onboard exceptional talent that fits The Flex’s high‑performance culture.
  • Founder Leverage – Act as an extension of the CEO—anticipating needs, managing priorities, and keeping the organization aligned.
  • Growth & Partnerships – Support business development efforts and nurture relationships with partners, investors, and key stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • 2–5 years of experience in startups, consulting, operations, or venture building.
  • A strong mix of strategic thinking and hands‑on execution.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to thrive in fast‑changing, high‑pressure environments.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset— you don’t wait for direction; you make things happen.
  • Curiosity for real estate tech, automation, and scaling businesses.

Why Join The Flex

  • Work directly with the founder. Learn how to build, scale, and operate a global business.
  • Accelerate your career. This is a launchpad to senior leadership or your own venture.
  • High‑impact role. You’ll directly shape company direction and execution.
  • Remote‑first. Work from anywhere with autonomy and ownership.
  • Competitive compensation + performance‑based incentives.
  • Elite culture. Join a team obsessed with speed, precision, and excellence.

Do Not Apply If

  • You want a predictable, structured 9–5 job.
  • You prefer comfort over challenge.
  • You avoid accountability or ambiguity.
  • You’re not striving to be among the top 1% in your craft.

The Flex isn’t just a property company — it’s a global ecosystem for flexible living, powered by technology, automation, and ambition. If you want to work side‑by‑side with a founder building at speed and scale, and learn how to build a global business from zero to one—apply now.
