description:
Join to apply for the Data Engineer role at Tort Experts

About Tort Experts

We are redefining the landscape of performance marketing in the legal sector. Our mission is to democratize access to information for individuals who have been injured, connecting them with law firms that truly advocate for their rights and achieve successful outcomes. As an innovative, vertically integrated legal case acquisition marketing company, we leverage cutting‑edge technology, data‑driven insights, and a commitment to transparency to disrupt the status quo.

Joining Tort Experts means becoming part of a dynamic team that is passionate about making a meaningful impact. We foster a collaborative environment where creativity thrives, and every team member plays a vital role in connecting qualified claimants with the representation they deserve.

About the Role

The Data Engineer will design, build, and maintain the architecture and systems that enable efficient collection, storage, processing, and analysis of data. This role ensures that all company data—including marketing, affiliate, intake, and operational data—flows seamlessly through the system, is stored securely, and is readily accessible for analysis and reporting.

This position requires a skilled engineer with a passion for working with data, solving complex problems, and building systems that support business needs. You will collaborate closely with the Business Intelligence team to ensure that our data infrastructure supports the growing needs of the organization.

Location

Remote (must be available 9 am – 5 pm Eastern Time)

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest, transform, and store data from multiple internal and external sources.
  • Collaborate with the Marketing, Client Services, Accounting and Business Intelligence teams to ensure data availability and quality for reporting, analysis, and decision‑making.
  • Implement data integrations with platforms like Leadspedia, Retool, Salesforce, Looker, and other internal tools.
  • Ensure the data infrastructure is optimized for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Automate data workflows and processes to reduce manual data handling and improve operational efficiency.
  • Maintain and optimize the company’s data warehouse, ensuring that all data is stored securely and is easily accessible.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data‑related issues, ensuring timely resolution and minimal impact on operations.
  • Design and implement data quality controls, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and completeness across the company’s systems.
  • Work with the tech team to ensure compliance with data security and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide technical support and guidance for internal teams on data‑related issues and queries.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a related technical field.
  • Strong experience with SQL, Python, and/or other programming languages used for data processing and transformation.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) and tools like BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
  • Proficiency in data integration tools and technologies (ETL processes, data pipelines, API integration).
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets and optimizing data workflows for performance.
  • Familiarity with data security practices, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve data issues efficiently.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively across cross‑functional teams.

Benefits

  • Uncapped quarterly profit‑sharing bonuses based on company performance.
  • 100% company‑paid monthly premiums for Fortune 500‑level quality insurance plans for you and any/all dependents (US‑based employees):
    • Medical (Aetna)
    • Dental (Guardian)
    • Vision (Guardian)
  • 100% company match on any employee contributions to either HSA or FSA flex benefits plans (US‑based employees):
    • $500 free FSA company contribution, even if $0 employee contribution.
  • 401(k) plan with full company match of up to 6% of salary and no vesting period required (US‑based employees).
  • Unlimited paid time off with planned role/responsibilities coverage.
  • Work‑from‑home equipment budget (at company’s discretion).
  • Forever remote work environment.

Why Join Us?

At Tort Experts, we believe in empowering our team members with growth opportunities, a flexible work environment, and the chance to make a tangible impact. If you thrive in fast‑paced environments and are driven, client‑focused, and eager to contribute to our mission of connecting clients with top‑tier legal representation, we want you on our team.

description:
Missão do Cargo Traduzir desafios de negócio em soluções inteligentes baseadas em Machine Learning (ML). Você colaborará de perto com diversas equipes (Engenharia, Produto, Negócios) para identificar oportunidades, desenvolver modelos robustos e implementá-los em produção, gerando impacto real e valor tangível para nossos produtos e clientes.

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Resolver Problemas: Transformar problemas de negócio em projetos claros e bem definidos de Machine Learning.
  • Colaborar: Trabalhar em conjunto com Engenheiros de Dados, Product Managers e Analistas de Negócios para identificar e validar oportunidades onde ML pode fazer a diferença.
  • Desenvolver Modelos: Projetar, treinar, validar e otimizar modelos de Machine Learning (usando técnicas como árvores de decisão, redes neurais, aprendizado supervisionado/não supervisionado, etc.), com foco na qualidade da engenharia de features e na análise crítica dos resultados.
  • Implementar Soluções: Colocar modelos de ML em produção, monitorar seu desempenho e garantir que eles entreguem o valor esperado em ambientes reais.
  • Experimentar e Inovar: Conduzir experimentos, desenvolver protótipos (PoCs) e testar novas abordagens para resolver problemas complexos com dados.
  • Disseminar Conhecimento: Criar documentação técnica, compartilhar aprendizados e contribuir para a cultura de dados e ML na empresa, possivelmente através de apresentações ou treinamentos internos.

O que esperamos de você

  • Fundamentos Sólidos: Excelente base em estatística, matemática e nos princípios de Machine Learning.
  • Programação: Proficiência em programação, especialmente Python e suas bibliotecas principais para Data Science (ex: Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
  • Experiência Prática: Experiência comprovada na construção e implementação de modelos de ML em projetos reais, utilizando frameworks populares (ex: TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, Scikit-learn).
  • Boas Práticas: Familiaridade com boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (versionamento com Git, testes) e MLOps. Noções de otimização de performance (CPU/GPU, memória, I/O).
  • Mindset: Proatividade, curiosidade, pensamento analítico e um forte desejo de entender como ML/IA podem impactar positivamente o negócio.
  • Comunicação: Habilidade para comunicar ideias complexas de forma clara para diferentes públicos.
  • Formação: Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Física ou áreas correlatas.

Diferencial

  • Cloud Computing: Experiência com plataformas de nuvem, especialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e seus serviços (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc).
  • NLP: Conhecimento e/ou experiência com Processamento de Linguagem Natural.
  • Big Data: Experiência no processamento de grandes volumes de dados com ferramentas como Spark, Beam ou Dask. Familiaridade com Data Lakes e Data Warehouses modernos.
  • Ética em IA: Consciência sobre as implicações éticas, de privacidade e explicabilidade (XAI) no uso de Inteligência Artificial.
  • Acadêmico: Pós-graduação (Mestrado ou Doutorado) em áreas relacionadas.

  • Managing, responding to and fixing critical incidents and issues through to completion.

What You Bring To Ledn

7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.

Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc., and to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.

Experience integrating SSO into Okta, creating workflows in Okta, working with APIs, and integrating systems.

Remote support experience across multiple time zones, familiarity with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.

Strong communication skills, clear writing, and a desire to provide a magical experience for others.

Security awareness (e.g., PGP) and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching).

Self‑management, strong organizational and task‑management skills, and the ability to handle ambiguity.

Nice To Haves

Some familiarity with AWS; use of tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces.

Jamf, Okta, and Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

Leadership with resilience, adaptability, and a builder’s mindset.

Collaborative partner with empathy and clarity.

Demonstrated integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse cultural contexts.

Experience working in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day.

Competitive PTO package ensuring you have the time off you deserve.

Ownership in the company through shared equity.

Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

Clear purpose and support that removes barriers so you love what you do.

The team

We’re hiring Data Analysts to join our Compliance Enterprise Client Data Office team, working remotely from India! This role is centered on building and enhancing compliance dashboarding, analytics, and insights — the core responsibility of the position. The candidate must be passionate about creating dashboards that deliver clear, actionable insights, as this will be the main focus of the role.

As a Data Analyst, you will own core responsibilities such as designing scalable compliance dashboards, analytics, and metrics, architecting automated pipelines and audit-ready regulatory reports, and translating plain-language business or regulatory requests into precise data models. You’ll partner closely with leaders across Compliance, Risk, and other stakeholders to strengthen our compliance posture and ensure regulators and executives have visibility into accurate, meaningful insights. Your ability to contextualize data within the broader business and risk landscape, and communicate those insights to both technical and non-technical audiences, will be essential.

In addition to these core responsibilities, you will also provide ad-hoc support where needed: managing data requests, assisting with regulatory reporting, supporting automation and peer code reviews, and developing tactical solutions that free up Product and Engineering teams to focus on long-term improvements. The ability to juggle multiple projects simultaneously, communicate effectively in a fully remote environment, and leverage AI to create scalable frameworks will be key to success.

Ultimately, this is a critical role shaping Kraken’s compliance and client data strategy, aligning data practices with ambitious business objectives, and navigating the complexities of an evolving regulatory landscape with rigor, creativity, and precision.

The opportunity

  • Develop and maintain high-quality data sources in partnership with Data and Engineering teams.

  • Build key datasets and data pipelines using Python and ETL frameworks (e.g., Airflow).

  • Design and automate reports, dashboards, and compliance metrics ensuring consistency, accuracy, and actionable insights for business partners across the business.

  • Work closely with Regional Compliance Officers to deliver audit-ready regulatory reports.

  • Build client data dashboards for Executive Leadership, providing insights on trends, KPIs, demographics, and growth opportunities.

  • Monitor and improve client data quality by identifying issues, driving remediations, and coordinating timely resolutions.

  • Automate compliance governance controls and monitoring to ensure processes operate as expected.

  • Provide cross-functional support during peak periods (requirements definition, backlog management, QA triage) to maintain delivery timelines.

  • Develop ad-hoc compliance solutions to enable Product Development and Engineering teams to focus on long-term improvements.

  • Support ad-hoc data requests for audits, exams, risk assessments, and day-to-day business needs.

Skills you should HODL

  • 3+ years industry experience in data analysis and data management

  • 2+ years experience in Compliance and Regulatory Reporting areas

  • Advanced knowledge of SQL, scripting languages and database concepts with a record of performing data analysis using a scripting language

  • Expert in Python for data analysis, automation, and building scalable applications, with high proficiency in libraries, frameworks, and scripting for complex workflows

  • Hands-on experience with, AWS, Airflow, Cursor, and BI tools such as QuickSight or Superset

  • Experience using compliance and investigation tools (e.g., Hummingbird, Moody’s RDC, Chainalysis, Elliptic) to support regulatory reporting, monitoring, and risk analysis.

  • Ability to synthesize ambiguous regulatory requests into technical requirements

  • Familiarity with data warehouse development and best practices

  • Ability to clearly present reports, dashboards and complex results to Executives

  • You believe wholeheartedly in the cypherpunk, libertarian values outlined in Kraken’s Tentaclements document.

  • Must be based in India and fluent in English

Nice to Haves

  • Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related technical field.

  • Knowledge of AML/FCC, Sanctions, KYC, MiCA, MiFID, or Data Governance regulations.

  • Passionate about crypto with deep knowledge of emerging trends and tokens beyond blue chips

Essa jornada nos permitiu acumular valiosa experiência e nos destacar como líderes em oferecer as melhores práticas do mercado. Além de nosso conhecimento aprofundado, a segurança é uma prioridade essencial para nós. Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados e determinados para se juntarem a nós como Analista de Qualidade. Se você tem vontade de aprender, transformar a logística e mobilidade e fazer a diferença, essa é a sua oportunidade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida como QA em processos de desenvolvimento de software.

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!
Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.
We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.
Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients — in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.
What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.
The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.
Combining these values with our conviction makes Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.
Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full‑time Manager of IT.
The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud‑based IT systems and tools.
A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security‑first environments.
The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.
But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever‑changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.
You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast‑moving and highly execution‑oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

About the Role

This role will report to the Director of IT. You will be customer‑facing, and the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.
You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.). You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open‑source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Do you integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack.
  • You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time.
  • You can self‑manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
The ideal candidate will:
• Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
• Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
• Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
• Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
• Have worked in a remote environment before.
• Taste of What We Provide.

What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. A comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.
Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.
You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process.
Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
We are a remote first environment. Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted.
As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please.
We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Nosso Jeito de Ser:

  • Transparência e clareza em todas as relações.
  • Cultura colaborativa – humildade para reconhecer quando precisa de ajuda e disposição para ajudar quem precisa de ajuda.
  • Aprendizado contínuo – Para entregar excelência, precisamos nos aprimorar o tempo todo.
  • Agilidade – Testar rápido faz parte do nosso DNA.

Se essa cultura faz sentido para você, venha fazer parte da Staage!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Customer Success Pleno(a)

Você será responsável pelo onboarding completo, acompanhamento próximo dos resultados, identificação de oportunidades de melhoria e construção de relacionamentos sólidos. Conhecimentos (Saber)

  • Colaborar com Vendas, Marketing e Operações para compartilhar insights e garantir sucesso contínuo do cliente.

Atitudes (Saber Ser)

  • Ser sociável e bom de criar relacionamento.
  • Agir com flexibilidade e adaptação aos membros, mudando o estilo e tom de acordo com cada pessoa.
  • Foco em gerar resultados mensuráveis aos membros.
  • Conseguir lidar com situações de possível insatisfação do membro e solucionar.
  • Identificar gaps de melhoria para o produto.

Responsabilidades

  • Mapear o engajamento do grupo e engajamento individual de cada membro/cliente de forma diária.
  • Realizar o networking entre os membros de forma ativa.
  • Garantir a ciência da integralidade dos avisos aos membros participantes.
  • Adicionar novos membros, acompanhar e auxiliar os membros do grupo de WhatsApp e na plataforma, auxiliando nas dúvidas e dificuldades existentes sobre o funcionamento dos eventos, masterminds, plataforma e grupo de WhatsApp.

  • Entrar em contato com os membros/clientes sempre que as renovações das assinaturas expirarem, bem como remover das plataformas e grupo de WhatsApp aqueles membros que não realizarem a renovação.
  • Compreender e conhecer a atividade, a empresa e cada membro/cliente, bem como realizar contato periodicamente com cada um.

  • Trazer e sugerir melhorias para a experiência do cliente.

As MetaCTO’s Content Marketing Manager , you’ll own the storytelling engine that powers our brand growth. You’ll transform client wins, technical breakthroughs, and leadership insights into content that attracts leads, strengthens partnerships, and builds authority in the mobile and AI ecosystem. You’ll collaborate closely with founders, project managers, and engineers to uncover the real value behind our projects and turn it into stories that resonate with startups and product leaders worldwide.

What You’ll Do

1. Case Studies & Success Stories

  • Collaborate with design and marketing to publish across MetaCTO.com, Clutch, and partner platforms.

2. Newsletters & Email Marketing

  • Plan and write monthly newsletters highlighting product launches, insights, and client stories.
  • Test subject lines, visuals, and calls‑to‑action to maximize engagement.
  • Analyze performance data and recommend improvements for future campaigns.

3. Content Strategy & Operations

  • Maintain a 90‑day content calendar covering website, email, and social channels.
  • Align content themes with MetaCTO’s strategic initiatives—AI enablement, rapid MVPs, app monetization, and platform growth.
  • Streamline workflows and templates to make content production fast and repeatable.

4. Brand & Voice Development

  • Maintain a consistent brand tone—clear, confident, and optimistic.
  • Ensure all content reflects MetaCTO’s values: clarity, speed, and technical depth.

5. Analytics & Optimization

  • Track key performance metrics and present quarterly reports on content effectiveness.
  • Identify new opportunities for SEO growth and inbound lead generation.

Key Objectives (Quarterly OKRs)

  • O1: Strengthen MetaCTO’s credibility through storytelling – Publish 4+ new case studies per quarter, increase engagement and shares, expand visibility on partner and client platforms.
  • O2: Build and engage an audience of potential clients and partners – Launch a monthly newsletter with strong engagement, grow email subscribers and LinkedIn followers, generate inbound leads through content.
  • O3: Systematize and scale content production – Establish templates and workflows, reduce leadership time on content creation by 50%.

Ideal Candidate

  • Based in Brazil , fluent in English and Portuguese .
  • 3–6 years of experience in B2B tech or agency content marketing .
  • Strong storytelling skills with the ability to translate technical achievements into business value.
  • Proven experience writing case studies, newsletters, or blog content for software or AI companies.
  • Proficiency with marketing tools (HubSpot, Notion, Google Analytics, LinkedIn).
  • Bonus: familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Jasper) or SEO best practices.

Why Join MetaCTO

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About the Company

SuperSummary is transforming how millions of readers discover, understand, and connect with books. We're building the world's most comprehensive literature platform - combining nearly 10,000 expert-written Study Guides with interactive, innovative tools that make reading more engaging, rewarding, and fun.

Beyond summaries, our paid subscription offers chapter-by-chapter analysis, character breakdowns, themes and symbols exploration, thought-provoking discussion questions, and interactive quizzes. Our growing suite of AI-powered features helps readers engage more deeply with texts, whether they're students tackling assignments, teachers preparing lessons, book clubs seeking richer conversations, or lifelong learners exploring new genres.

Founded over a decade ago, SuperSummary’s website and mobile app has become a trusted, go-to resource for curious readers worldwide. We’re part of the Lift Ventures portfolio of EdTech brands (with over 250 million consumers reached to date) and are a fully remote, global team united by curiosity, creativity, and a shared love of learning.

About the Job

SuperSummary is looking for a seasoned, data-driven Performance Marketing Manager to own and scale our paid acquisition channels. You'll be responsible for driving efficient subscriber growth across our core established channels— including Google Ads, Meta, and Apple Search Ads— while pioneering expansion into other promising new channels like TikTok Ads and Creator/Affiliate Partnerships. This role is an opportunity to directly shape how millions of readers discover SuperSummary, combining analytical rigor with hands‑on creative experimentation to drive sustainable growth and ROAS improvements across channels.

You'll work cross‑functionally with our Product, Content, and Analytics teams to develop sophisticated, highly-targeted campaigns that reach students, educators, book club members, and lifelong learners wherever they are. The ideal candidate thrives on experimentation, stays ahead of platform changes, and can balance immediate performance goals with long-term brand building.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage and optimize daily paid media budgets and campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, Apple Search Ads, and other channels to hit CAC and ROAS targets
  • Lead expansion into new ad channels (TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, etc.) and test new strategies (video ads, influencer and affiliate marketing, etc.) to diversify our acquisition mix
  • Develop AI-powered creative testing frameworks in collaboration with designers and copywriters to continuously improve ad performance
  • Build and refine audience segments, bidding strategies, and attribution models to improve efficiency across the funnel
  • Own the performance marketing budget , allocating resources across channels based on incrementality and strategic priorities
  • Run in-depth analyses on website/app engagement, conversion funnel performance, and A/B test performance for paid ads traffic to better understand opportunities for improvement
  • Report on performance to leadership with clear insights and recommendations for optimization
  • Stay current on platform updates , industry trends, and competitive landscape to identify new opportunities

Sample Projects

  • Google Ads deep dive: run AI-powered analyses on our existing strategy to identify and test new keyword/targeting strategies, copy and creative improvements, and bid optimizations
  • TikTok pilot program : Collaborate with our Content team to build SuperSummary's presence on TikTok from scratch, testing BookTok creator partnerships, spark ads, and in‑feed video to establish benchmarks and scale strategy
  • Landing page optimization : Work with Product and Design to build and test dedicated landing pages for key campaigns, improving conversion rates across channels
  • App Store Optimization: Test improvements to our mobile app marketing strategy (new keywords, descriptions, images, etc.) to improve the performance of our app-focused campaigns

Who You Are

  • 4-7+ years of performance marketing/paid media experience at high‑growth companies with particular expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads
  • Proven track record of scaling high‑volume paid channels (via both web and mobile app‑based products) while maintaining or improving efficiency metrics
  • Strong design and copywriting sense and ability to develop effective creative strategies alongside Content and Product team members
  • In‑depth analytical skills with experience using top analytics and A/B testing platforms (Google Analytics, Amplitude, etc.)
  • Prior experience using AI for creative experimentation, campaign analysis, and marketing automation
  • Experience with creator/influencer‑driven marketing strategies on channels like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.
  • Excellent communicator who thrives in a fully remote, highly collaborative team.
  • B2C, SaaS/subscription, EdTech, or related experience is highly preferred.
  • Work with a distributed, global team in Latin America, Europe, and the US that has been remote‑first since 2018
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and vacation policy
  • Workspace improvement stipend
  • Professional development and learning stipend

About Daydream

Daydream is building the Hugging Face of real-time, interactive video AI: a powerful, open-source platform and vibrant community of developers, researchers, and creatives working together to advance the next generation of cutting-edge AI models and interactivity.

The Product

Daydream’s real time video AI & community platform includes:

  • The leading interactive AI platform for Touch Designer and StreamDiffusion
  • The leading knowledge base & community hub for real time AI and world models
  • A community of over 2,000 creative technologists, builders, and applied researchers

Daydream is a part of Livepeer, powering interactive live streaming for a global customer base, from top 15 global companies to world famous festivals like Burning Man.

The Role

We are looking to hire an execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to join our ever growing marketing team. Initially, the role would involve helping us understand and connect with our users, crafting the story of the product, producing content, developing launch plans and coordinating those launches, and helping with partnerships enablement.

What you’ll do

Craft the Story: Develop clear, compelling narratives around our product, features, and vision.

Launch & GTM: Plan and execute product and feature launches. Collaborate on distribution strategies across channels like X, Discord, Reddit, newsletters, community platforms, and earned media.

Content Production: Write or coordinate blog posts, landing pages, technical explainers, and demo content that resonates with our users.

Partnerships Enablement: Create decks, one-pagers, and case studies to support partnership and sales efforts.

Measure & Iterate: Track engagement, growth, and feedback to continuously refine messaging, positioning, and marketing strategies.

Vendor Management: Collaborate with external agencies, freelancers, and partners to scale marketing output efficiently. This includes drafting clear briefs, setting expectations and timelines, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring work is aligned with brand voice, quality standards, and strategic goals.

Reporting: Create regular performance reports on campaigns, launches, and content, providing insights and recommendations to guide strategic decisions.

About you

Must-have experience

Background in AI or Developer Tools: You’ve marketed a product in the AI space and can speak the language of developers and technical audiences.

Strong Execution Skills: You move fast, prioritize ruthlessly, and deliver high-quality work on time.

Excellent Storyteller: You know how to distill complex ideas into clear, compelling messages.

Creative & Curious: You're excited to experiment, iterate, and help shape a new product in an emerging category.

Open Source Familiarity: Bonus points if you’ve worked with or marketed open-source projects before.

Remote Collaboration Skills: You’re self-directed, organized, and great at async communication in a distributed team.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Base Salary: We will offer a competitive market rate based on experience and location.
  • Token package: Competitive token package with a 3-year vesting schedule
  • Employee Stock Option Plan: Competitive ESOP with 4-year vesting and a 1-year cliff.
  • Annual Adjusted Salaries: Every January, we review and adjust pay.
  • Holidays: 25 vacation days per year plus any national holidays. A day off on your birthday, because you deserve to celebrate! (If it falls on a weekend, take another day off that week.)
  • Learning and Development Budget: 2,000 USD per year to invest in courses, certifications, or workshops to grow in your role.
  • Insurance: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance in applicable locations.
  • Pension: Company pension contributions in applicable locations.
  • Equipment: Choose a laptop of your preference and anything you need for a comfortable work setup (we’ll purchase it for you)
  • Home Office Upgrades: 300 USD every two years to refresh your workspace at home.
  • Flexible Working: Flexible hours to support work-life balance.
  • Annual Company Retreat: Once a year, we fly the whole company to an exciting global location for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun—all expenses covered
  • Team Meetups: Each team comes together in person once a year to build trust, spark ideas, and share meaningful moments that go beyond the screen.
  • Subscription Gift: 250 USD per year to spend on a personal subscription of your choice.
  • Work Anniversary Rewards: At Livepeer, we love recognising your journey. As you reach 3, 4, 5 years and beyond, you'll be celebrated with gift card rewards.
  • Celebrate Life’s Big Moments: Whether it’s a wedding, a new baby, or another major milestone, we’ll mark the occasion with a celebration gift.
  • Referral Bonus: Refer great talent to Livepeer and earn 100 LPT tokens when they’re hired and successfully complete their probation.
  • Latest Tech: Work with cutting-edge AI and the latest technologies alongside an innovative and entrepreneurial team.

Em 2017, a Companhia deu início à sua trajetória de investimentos com a aquisição do Hospital Vera Cruz, localizado em Campinas-SP. Essas aquisições reforçam as consolidações da nossa região, que fazem parte do grupo Hospital Care. Fundado em 2017, o Hospital Care nasceu da união de pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar no Brasil. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde, com um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, focado no equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Nosso sistema de saúde é completo, com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia, estamos presentes em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais de gestão de saúde, nos estados de São Paulo, Paraná e Santa Catarina. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos consolidar como a principal Rede de Prestadores de Serviços de Saúde do Brasil.
